recordCall(String, boolean, RecordFormat, RecordDirection) - Method in class com.signalwire.sdk.swaig.FunctionResult
Fully-typed overload of FunctionResult.recordCall(String, boolean, String, String): both the container format (RecordFormat) and the audio direction (RecordDirection) are typed closed sets.
recordCall(String, boolean, RecordFormat, RecordDirection, String, boolean, double, Double, Double, Double, String) - Method in class com.signalwire.sdk.swaig.FunctionResult
Fully-typed, full-arity overload of FunctionResult.recordCall(String, boolean, String, String, String, boolean, double, Double, Double, Double, String): the closed-set format (RecordFormat) and direction (RecordDirection) are typed so a misspelled container format or direction fails at compile time instead of being rejected by the server's ValueError, while every Python record_call optional (terminators / beep / input_sensitivity / initial_timeout / end_silence_timeout / max_length / status_url) is still exposed positionally.
